# An ExecuteTemplate call whose template name is not a string literal, as in
# a render helper, is not type checked: which template it renders is known
# only at run time. check names each such call on stderr so the templates it
# renders are not silently unchecked, and counts them in its summary. Such
# a call may render any template, so none is reported unused: "about",
# rendered only through the helper, does not fail the check.

muxt check
cmpenv stderr want-skipped.txt
cmp stdout want-ok.txt

-- want-skipped.txt --
$WORK/server.go:24:9: ExecuteTemplate not checked: the template name is not a string literal, so which template it renders is not known until run time
-- want-ok.txt --
ok: 1 template, 1 call site skipped
-- go.mod --
module example.com

go 1.24
-- index.gohtml --
{{define "index"}}<h1>{{.Title}}</h1>{{end}}
{{define "about"}}<h1>{{.Title}}</h1>{{end}}
-- server.go --
package server

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
	"io"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var source embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(source, "*"))

type Page struct {
	Title string
}

func RenderIndex(w io.Writer, page Page) error {
	return templates.ExecuteTemplate(w, "index", page)
}

// render is a helper; check cannot tell which template name it is passed.
func render(w io.Writer, name string, data any) error {
	return templates.ExecuteTemplate(w, name, data)
}
